# Forward Deployed Product Engineer — The Walt Disney Company (Corporate)

---
**Job ID:** 10165150
**Date Posted:** Nov 13, 2026
**Date Applied:** Nov 15, 2026
**Salary Range:** $119,200–$159,800 per year — Glendale, CA
---

## Job Summary

A Product Manager role in Enterprise Technology for someone who has built and launched AI-powered products. The role identifies high-value business problems, defines product strategy and requirements, prioritizes opportunities, and partners with engineering, design, data, AI/ML, and business stakeholders to take solutions from concept through production and adoption. The posting asks for a portfolio ("We'd love to see something you've helped build"), and the team works in the office Monday through Thursday. It shares its title with application [[016 Disney - Forward Deployed Product Engineer|016]] (job 10158258), a separate, earlier requisition.

---

## What You'll Do

- Define the product vision, strategy, roadmap, and priorities for AI-powered products and capabilities.
- Identify high-value business and user problems and translate them into product requirements, user stories, workflows, and success criteria.
- Lead product discovery with users and stakeholders: understand pain points, validate opportunities, and test assumptions.
- Partner with engineering, AI/ML, data, design, and business teams from concept and prototype through production launch and iteration.
- Prioritize features and investments by customer value, business impact, technical feasibility, risk, and effort.
- Define measurable product outcomes and KPIs, and use product analytics, user feedback, and experimentation to guide decisions.
- Shape AI-powered user experiences, including workflows, automation, agent interactions, and human-in-the-loop decision points.
- Help define effective uses of LLM APIs, prompt design, RAG, agents, and AI evaluation approaches.
- Set quality, evaluation, security, privacy, monitoring, and reliability expectations for AI products with technical teams.
- Drive pilots and prototypes with real users and decide whether to iterate, scale, or discontinue.
- Communicate tradeoffs, decisions, dependencies, and priorities to technical teams and senior stakeholders.
- Drive launches, adoption, change management, and continuous improvement across enterprise users and business teams.

### Required Qualifications
- 3+ years of Technical Product Management experience building and shipping software products for production users
- Experience contributing to or leading the development of AI, GenAI, LLM-powered, data, or other technically complex products
- Demonstrated experience defining product strategy, roadmaps, requirements, priorities, and measurable success criteria
- Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle and experience partnering directly with software engineering, data, AI/ML, and/or design teams
- Working knowledge of modern AI concepts and methods, including LLMs, prompt design, agents, RAG, APIs, and evaluation
- Experience conducting product discovery, gathering user feedback, validating requirements, and turning ambiguous business problems into product direction
- Experience using data, experimentation, qualitative feedback, and product metrics to inform prioritization
- Strong written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical stakeholders; learning agility
- Preferred: launching AI/GenAI products into production; RAG, agentic workflows, model selection, evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, human evaluation, LLM-as-judge, trace analysis, production monitoring); prototyping with Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar; working with AI engineers, data scientists, or forward-deployed engineering teams; taking products from 0-to-1; work across business areas such as media, parks, retail, operations, HR, or finance; enterprise-scale data, legacy systems, and governance; experience as a founder, builder, designer, engineer, or operator

### Education
Bachelor's degree and/or equivalent work experience.

### Benefits
A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Nov 15, 2026

- **Concept through production users:** ExtrusionStudio went from a LabVIEW proof of concept to a Python service live on three extrusion lines since October 2026, with a view per audience and requirements gathered from the technicians and operators who use it. The ICARUS-Lite was commercialized against unit goals of 60 in 2025 and 100 in 2026, and the Business Central launch migrated more than 2,000 items and 150+ products in five weeks.
- **AI development tools are a direct match for the preferred list:** Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and local LLMs in LM Studio in daily use, with AI-assisted scripts tested locally before deployment. An AI rework of a solid part cut its material use by 16.2% and its quoted price per part by 21.29%. This site's agent skills, skill router, and validation scripts show agent workflows with a human check on the output.
- **AI inside a product:** an LLM is being built into the next branch of ExtrusionStudio, and ProteorPrintOS with SimplyPrint adds AI-assisted diagnostics (per the [[Career Q&A Log]], the first from a partial answer).
- **Stakeholders and communication:** monthly USA review with leadership from Proteor's global locations; product-development pipeline and technology strategy as CTO of Filament Innovations.
- **Gaps:** no Technical Product Management title, let alone three years of one; no RAG; no GenAI or LLM product launched to production; no evaluation frameworks (golden datasets, LLM-as-judge, trace analysis); no product analytics, experimentation, or KPI work on the record; no work with data scientists or AI engineers; none of the named business areas (media, parks, retail, HR, finance). These were kept out of the resume.
- **Fit:** a reach on the product-management title and AI evaluation depth; the case is a builder who takes technically complex products to production users and works with AI development tools daily.

### Now — Nov 15, 2026

Nothing has changed since the application.

## About the Company

The Walt Disney Company (Corporate) houses Disney's enterprise functions. Enterprise Technology's stated mission is to deliver technology solutions that align with business strategies, enable enterprise efficiency, and promote cross-company collaborative innovation. The position is with Disney Worldwide Services, Inc.
